new='''        evicted = []
        lost = []
        if pbytes > self.pifo_limit:
            # Existing PIFO bytes were already within the limit, so the
            # excess can be removed by one descending suffix walk.  This is
            # materially cheaper than rebuilding a root for every pushout.
            excess = pbytes - self.pifo_limit
            remove_keys = []
            stack = []
            node = pifo
            removed_bytes = 0
            while (node is not None or stack) and removed_bytes < excess:
                while node is not None:
                    stack.append(node)
                    node = node.right
                node = stack.pop()
                pkt = node.value
                remove_keys.append(node.key)
                lost.append(pkt)
                evicted.append(pkt.pktid)
                removed_bytes += pkt.length
                node = node.left
            pifo = erase_many(pifo, sorted(remove_keys))
            pbytes -= removed_bytes
            self.residents = erase_many(self.residents, sorted(pkt.ordinal for pkt in lost))
            self.ranks = rank_remove_many(self.ranks, sorted(pkt.rank for pkt in lost))
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
